pattern_explanation: These Spanish words came into the language from Latin and French forms that look like English words, but over time their meanings shifted in Spanish, so the forms stayed close while the meanings separated.
false_friend_warning: The Spanish words transliterated as actual, libreria, asistir and sensible look close to the English words actual, library, assist and sensible, but they mean current, bookstore, attend and sensitive, so a learner who trusts the similar form will pick the wrong meaning.
